import hashlib
import json
import os
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
from unittest.mock import patch

from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.campaign_usage import combine_usage, parse_session_usage
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.phase_gate import GateConfigError, decide_phase

from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.test_phase_gate import PhaseGateCliTest, views

SID="11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
SID2="22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
CWD="/synthetic/a2-v2-rereview"
PROVIDER="openai-codex"
MODEL="gpt-5.6-sol"

def encoded(rows):
    return ("\n".join(json.dumps(row,separators=(",",":")) for row in rows)+"\n").encode()

def header(sid=SID):
    return {"type":"session","version":3,"id":sid,"cwd":CWD,"timestamp":"synthetic","rlmDepth":0}

def assistant(entry="a1",parent=None,response="resp-a"):
    message={"role":"assistant","provider":PROVIDER,"model":MODEL,"stopReason":"stop",
             "usage":{"input":10,"output":5,"cacheRead":100,"cacheWrite":3,"totalTokens":118}}
    if response is not None:message["responseId"]=response
    return {"type":"message","id":entry,"parentId":parent,"timestamp":"synthetic","message":message}

def run_case(body):
    case=PhaseGateCliTest(methodName="test_reads_same_bridge_views_and_publishes_hashed_native_usage_ready")
    case.setUp()
    try:return body(case)
    finally:case.tearDown()

def gate_rollback_missing(case):
    first=case.call();path=next(case.session.iterdir())
    path.write_bytes(b"".join(case.native.splitlines(keepends=True)[:-1]))
    rollback=case.call();path.unlink();missing=case.call()
    return first,rollback,missing
first,rollback,missing=run_case(gate_rollback_missing)
print("F01_first="+first["decision"]["outcome"]+":"+str(first["usage"]["total_tokens"]))
print("F01_fresh_rollback="+rollback["decision"]["outcome"]+":"+str(rollback["usage"]["total_tokens"]))
print("F01_fresh_missing="+missing["decision"]["outcome"]+":"+str(missing["usage"]["total_tokens"]))

def gate_partial_sticky(case):
    path=next(case.session.iterdir());path.write_bytes(case.native[:-1]);bad=case.call()
    path.write_bytes(case.native);again=case.call();return bad,again
bad,again=run_case(gate_partial_sticky)
print("F01_partial="+bad["decision"]["outcome"]+":"+str(bad["usage"]["total_tokens"]))
print("F01_partial_repaired_but_sticky="+again["decision"]["outcome"]+":"+str(again["usage"]["total_tokens"]))

def gate_append_replace(case):
    path=next(case.session.iterdir());prefix=b"\n".join(case.native.split(b"\n")[:-2])+b"\n"
    path.write_bytes(prefix);one=case.call();path.write_bytes(case.native);two=case.call()
    replacement=case.root/"replacement.jsonl";replacement.write_bytes(case.native);replacement.replace(path)
    three=case.call();return one,two,three
one,two,three=run_case(gate_append_replace)
print("F01_valid_append="+str((one["usage"]["current_tokens"],two["usage"]["current_tokens"],two["decision"]["outcome"])))
print("F01_identical_replacement="+three["decision"]["outcome"]+":"+str(three["usage"]["current_tokens"]))

def gate_absent_start(case):
    path=next(case.session.iterdir());path.unlink();waiting=case.call();path.write_bytes(case.native);ready=case.call();return waiting,ready
waiting,ready=run_case(gate_absent_start)
print("F01_absent_start="+waiting["usage"]["state"]+":"+waiting["decision"]["outcome"])
print("F01_after_absent_valid_file="+ready["decision"]["outcome"]+":"+str(ready["usage"]["current_tokens"]))

def chain_hole(case):
    a=case.call();b=case.call();outcomes=sorted(case.outcomes.glob("*.json"));outcomes[0].unlink()
    try:case.call();blocked=False
    except GateConfigError:blocked=True
    return a,b,blocked,len(list(case.outcomes.glob("*.json")))
a,b,hole_blocked,hole_count=run_case(chain_hole)
print("CHAIN_contiguous="+str((a["sequence"],b["sequence"],b["previous_outcome_sha256"] is not None)))
print("CHAIN_hole_blocked="+str((hole_blocked,hole_count)))

def chain_corrupt(case):
    case.call();p=next(case.outcomes.glob("*.json"));p.write_bytes(p.read_bytes().replace(b'"sequence":1',b'"sequence":2'))
    try:case.call();return False
    except GateConfigError:return True
print("CHAIN_corruption_blocked="+str(run_case(chain_corrupt)))

def busy_lock(case):
    lock=case.outcomes/".gate-evaluation.lock";lock.write_bytes(b"foreign")
    try:case.call();blocked=False
    except GateConfigError:blocked=True
    return blocked,lock.read_bytes()==b"foreign"
print("CHAIN_O_EXCL_busy_lock="+str(run_case(busy_lock)))

def short_write(case):
    native=os.write
    def short(fd,data):return native(fd,data[:7])
    with patch("experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.phase_gate.os.write",side_effect=short):
        result=case.call()
    record=next(case.outcomes.glob("*.json"))
    return result["decision"]["outcome"],json.loads(record.read_bytes())["sequence"]
print("CHAIN_short_write_completed="+str(run_case(short_write)))

def partial_write(case):
    native=os.write;calls=0
    def interrupted(fd,data):
        nonlocal calls
        calls+=1
        if calls==3:raise OSError("synthetic")
        return native(fd,data if calls==1 else data[:11])
    with patch("experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.phase_gate.os.write",side_effect=interrupted):
        try:case.call();first_blocked=False
        except GateConfigError:first_blocked=True
    files=list(case.outcomes.glob("*.json"));size=files[0].stat().st_size
    try:case.call();next_blocked=False
    except GateConfigError:next_blocked=True
    return first_blocked,size,next_blocked,len(list(case.outcomes.glob("*.json")))
print("CHAIN_partial_write="+str(run_case(partial_write)))

def count_cap(case):
    for _ in range(40):case.call()
    try:case.call();blocked=False
    except GateConfigError:blocked=True
    return blocked,len(list(case.outcomes.glob("*.json")))
print("CHAIN_count_bound="+str(run_case(count_cap)))

missing_usage=parse_session_usage(encoded([header(),assistant(response=None)]),SID,CWD,PROVIDER,MODEL)
print("F03_missing_response="+str((missing_usage.complete,missing_usage.total_tokens,missing_usage.unknown_reasons)))
child={"type":"child_usage_attributed","id":"c1","parentId":"a1","timestamp":"synthetic",
       "aggregateUsage":{"input":5000,"output":200,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0,"totalTokens":5200}}
child_usage=parse_session_usage(encoded([header(),assistant(),child]),SID,CWD,PROVIDER,MODEL)
print("F02_child_attribution="+str((child_usage.complete,child_usage.total_tokens,child_usage.unknown_reasons)))

public,dev,research,usage=views();public["result"]["remaining_dev_opportunities"]=3
print("F04_contradictory_remaining="+decide_phase("initial",public,dev,research,usage,expected_rows=2).outcome)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hp-a2-v2-closure-") as tmp:
    tree=Path(tmp).resolve();(tree/"a").write_bytes(b"x")
    limits=ClosureLimits(8,1024,256,4,128);expected=capture_tree(tree,limits)
    try:verify_tree(tree,replace(expected,file_count=True),limits);rejected=False
    except ClosureError:rejected=True
    print("F05_boolean_expected_rejected="+str(rejected))

passing_controls: Fresh gate checkpoint restoration rejects rollback, missing file, exact-byte inode replacement and partial append while retaining last known counts and sticky stop.
Valid append advances known counts; absent startup is WAITING_FIRST_USAGE/NOT_READY and can accept the first later valid file.
Gate history enforces contiguous sequence/hash links, private exact file forms, O_EXCL evaluation lock, complete short writes, retained partial write failure and a 40-record/1MiB bound.
Unsupported child/global usage attribution and missing response identity yield incomplete usage without discarding known assistant categories.
Remaining opportunity conservation and strict expected SourceTree types/bounds reject the v1 mutations.
All four usage categories including cache reads remain in root campaign total; native_autonomous_tokens is not used as the campaign denominator.
external_conditions_and_nonclaims: Gate history is root-private and assumes no malicious concurrent same-UID mutator. Hash chaining does not prevent trusted wholesale deletion or tail replacement. No hostile-host claim.
Usage accounts completed responses only; no provider current-call hard cap or backpressure. Monitored overshoot remains.
STOP and READY intentionally exit 0. Parent accepts only the independently opened latest durable typed outcome plus provenance and a clean process receipt, never process 0/stdout alone.
Initial-to-continuation handoff and non-run/code/artifact final-lock fields remain parent/producer obligations outside these five repairs.
Source closure proves the declared tree only; not kernel-atomic execution, OS shared-library seal or whole-host isolation. Live installed capture was not rerun.
Original Faux capture has no response IDs and is UNKNOWN with 3745 known tokens. Derived positive fixture IDs are synthetic, not actual provider evidence.
Exact provider response identity, OAuth, full process integration, immutable source/config fan-in and separate process-callback repairs remain pending. Actual P0 remains blocked.
